o: Welcome to the Charmswell School for Royal Magic! Spend time with Sofia and her Royal Friends, where she takes you on a sparkling tour of her brand-new royal school, where every castle shines with its own special kind of magic. Along the way, she'll introduce you to her old and new friends — Pepper, Clover, Layla, Zane, and Camila — each with amazing talents and magical gifts of their own. With…

eps.o: It's Sofia's first day of royal magic school, and she teams up with new friends to win a race and gets a magical visit from Rapunzel.
Sofia joins a magical challenge against students from the other castles.
Layla tries a levitation spell but instead reveals her ability to sprout butterfly wings.
Sofia and Layla co-captain a magical parade, but they can't agree on anything.
Zane uses magic to improve his dance moves but when the charm becomes a curse, Sofia helps solve it.
Camila wants to be Cedric's apprentice but causes chaos with advanced spells.
Sofia is paired up with Zane's sister Zaria for a tri-castle activity, but they have nothing in common.
While on a family picnic, Amber wants to prove she's just as amazing as Sofia.
When Layla meets Sofia's siblings, Amber and James, she goes to extreme lengths to impress them.
Sofia and her new flying horse Wildfyre try out for the Charmswell Flying Derby.
Wanting to be good at potions, Zane accidentally creates out-of-control Green-Eyed Goo Monsters.
At a sleepover at Sofia's castle with Camilla and Layla, stuffies magically come to life.
A grumpy dragon is on the loose at Charmswell, and Zane tries to tame the bumbling beast.
Wanting to do a good deed, Amber helps Sofia with the village feast but causes some magical problems instead.
Sofia needs Layla's help to tame a mischievous magical flower.
Sofia defends Charmswell Academy from the wicked sorceress, Zandrya, with help from Rapunzel.
Camila learns to be there for her friends during the school's flying derby race.
Clover meets Pepper when he visits Sofia's castle, and Clover worries Sofia has a new best pet friend.
James accidentally breaks Sofia's wand and replaces it with a trick wand.
Sofia makes a wish that accidentally turns her mom into a kid.
Sofia helps Camila during a class project when they are overwhelmed by adorable puppercorns.
Zane accidentally loses Layla's treasured notebook in the Charmswell lake.
Camila lets a friendly troll borrow her wand, and the troll runs away with it.
Zane releases a mischievous goblin to help win a Hallow's Eve decoration contest.
Lucinda the Witch and Camila spend All Hallow's Eve with Sofia.
